notes: Read live off the bus: 0x500 broadcasts the VIN in three ASCII blocks
selected by byte 1 (see VIN_Block in the DBC). WMI MA3 = Maruti Suzuki
India, which independently confirms the make.
Derived from a SINGLE observed VIN, so this prefix may be too narrow
(missing other Dzire builds) or too wide (also matching Swift, which
shares the platform). Collect VINs from several cars to tighten it.
Only characters 1-9 are stored: manufacturer + model/body/powertrain.
The unit-identifying tail (plant, serial) is deliberately omitted, so
this identifies a MODEL, not a car.
Position 10 on this VIN is 'J', which ISO 3779 would read as model year
2018. That is NOT confirmed for Maruti Suzuki India and the folder
carries no year because of it - see the MG note in oem_packs/README.md
for why a VIN year code must not be trusted for an Indian marque.
